# Tech and work · 科技同返工

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20vocabulary%2Ftech-work).

Hong Kong office speech mixes in English words freely. The English words keep their English spelling here and are said much as in English, usually fitted to Cantonese rhythm. The fully Cantonese word is often more formal or written.

¹ **Usage notes**

- **執 bug** — 執 means to tidy up or sort out.
- **開 meeting** — The same as 開會, and very common in offices.
- **開 OT** — OT is overtime, said as two letters; the same as 加班.
- **部署** — Formal; in speech many developers simply say deploy.
- **伺服器** — Many people just say server.

The **classifier** is the measure word used when counting or pointing: 一**部**電腦, 呢**間**醫院. See [Number + Classifier + Noun](../grammar/number-classifier.md).
